mapper.select: SELECT p.id,p.name,p.description,p.mode,p.total_score,p.pass_score,p.duration_minutes,p.status,CASE WHEN p.mode='RANDOM' THEN COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r.single_count+r.multiple_count+r.true_false_count) FROM test_paper_random_bank r WHERE r.paper_id=p.id),0) ELSE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_paper_question pq WHERE pq.paper_id=p.id) END AS question_count,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM assessment_task a WHERE a.paper_id=p.id) AS hasAssessment FROM test_paper p p.name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_paper name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')

SELECT p.id,p.name,p.description,p.mode,p.total_score,p.pass_score,p.duration_minutes,p.status,CASE WHEN p.mode='RANDOM' THEN COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r.single_count+r.multiple_count+r.true_false_count) FROM test_paper_random_bank r WHERE r.paper_id=p.id),0) ELSE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_paper_question pq WHERE pq.paper_id=p.id) END AS question_count,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM assessment_task a WHERE a.paper_id=p.id) AS hasAssessment FROM test_paper p WHERE p.id=#{id}
